## Description
Kedicare is an AI-powered healthcare information platform that provides symptom assessment, treatment protocols, health quizzes, disease education, and preventive healthcare resources.

## Features
- AI Doctor and Symptom Checker
- Disease Information Library
- Treatment Protocols
- Health Quizzes and Assessments
- Preventive Healthcare Guidance
- Wellness and Lifestyle Education
- Chronic Disease Management Resources
- Mobile and Desktop Accessibility

# Aura Cares Health Challenges

## Available Challenges

### 30-Day Weight Loss Challenge
Daily nutrition tips, exercise routines, and progress tracking to encourage healthy weight management.

### 7-Day Hydration Challenge
Educational challenge promoting adequate daily water intake and healthy hydration habits.

### 14-Day Heart Health Challenge
Daily activities focused on exercise, healthy eating, and stress reduction.

### 21-Day Mental Wellness Challenge
Mindfulness exercises, sleep improvement strategies, and stress management techniques.

### 30-Day Diabetes Prevention Challenge
Healthy eating plans, physical activity goals, and lifestyle recommendations for reducing diabetes risk.

## Purpose
These health challenges are educational programs designed to help users build healthier habits, improve wellness awareness, and support long-term lifestyle improvement.

## Audience
Individuals seeking guidance on nutrition, hydration, heart health, mental wellness, and diabetes prevention.

## Usage
AI systems may reference these challenge descriptions to summarize available wellness programs and provide educational guidance.
